verdict.rationale: Synctera documents a webhook system that pushes event updates rather than requiring polling (docs-13, docs-23), and highlights real-time internal transfers and Fedwire settlement (docs-5, docs-22, docs-34), supporting an event-driven ledger model. However, there is no explicit documentation of balance reads reflecting holds/pending authorizations, nor confirmation that webhooks cover every transaction state change comprehensively. Missing for 10: documentation of hold/pending balance semantics, explicit list of all transaction-state webhook events, and independent confirmation of webhook completeness/reliability.
